# Attio — Style Reference

> graphite ink ruled onto a white ledger sheet. Medium-weight Inter Display on a #ffffff page, 1px hairlines at five percent black, and a single cobalt key reserved for the product itself.

**Theme:** light

Values are measured from the live site and normalized; names, roles and recommendations are interpretation. Font lists are independent, not paired by position. Example prompts describe reconstructions, not the site's source code.

Attio speaks a ledger-gray product language: a #ffffff canvas, #fbfbfb and #f4f5f6 bands for the logo wall and product stages, and every border drawn as a 1px hairline at #0000000d or #e6e7ea. The chrome gets exactly one hue, Signal Blue #266df0, confined to section labels and the mockups' own send buttons. Green, violet, amber and orange survive only as data inside product screenshots. Typography runs on a single weight: Inter and Inter Display at 500 account for 490 of 614 sampled text nodes, so hierarchy is carried by gray value instead. Headlines open in #242629 and finish in #75777c inside the same 40px block, on a 24, 32, 40px scale that steps a Perfect Fourth and then a Major Third. Shapes are soft (8px tiles, 10px buttons, 12px cards), and elevation is real but whisper-quiet: cool navy-tinted shadows held below 0.25 opacity. The page reads as an annotated spreadsheet rather than a SaaS billboard.

## Tokens — Colors

| Name | Value | Token | Role |
|---|---|---|---|
| Paper Canvas | `#ffffff` | `--color-paper-canvas` | The page, the app-window mockups, and secondary button fills — a pure white that lets 5%-black hairlines read as ruling rather than boxes. |
| Fog Surface | `#fbfbfb` | `--color-fog-surface` | Logo-wall band, feature-section bands, and the consent card backdrop — a 2% shift that marks a new zone without drawing a border. |
| Mist Panel | `#f4f5f6` | `--color-mist-panel` | Product-stage backgrounds behind floating mockups, nav-link hover fills, and mockup sidebars — the deepest neutral surface, so mockups sit one tonal step above it. |
| Jet Ink | `#101112` | `--color-jet-ink` | Announcement bar fill, the darkest headline words, and logo glyphs — 36 uses. It is the inverted surface, so do not use it as body text. |
| Graphite Ink | `#242629` | `--color-graphite-ink` | Body text, nav labels, the lead clause of every two-tone headline, and the primary CTA fill — the workhorse at 94 uses. It is the only ink allowed to fill a button. |
| Iron Body | `#505155` | `--color-iron-body` | Paragraph text inside product mockups, meeting descriptions, and link rows — a mid-dark gray that keeps mockup copy below the marketing headlines. |
| Slate Caption | `#75777c` | `--color-slate-caption` | The trailing clause of two-tone headlines, card descriptions, and secondary labels — 20 uses, and the signature second voice of the system. |
| Pewter Muted | `#9fa1a7` | `--color-pewter-muted` | Inactive tab-index items, placeholder text, and timestamps — 8 uses. It is the quietest ink and must not carry any sentence a reader needs. |
| Ash Hairline | `#0000000d` | `--color-ash-hairline` | Card edges, logo-icon outlines, mockup dividers and input rings — 43 uses at 5% black, so the line tints correctly on any of the three surfaces. |
| Dove Border | `#e6e7ea` | `--color-dove-border` | Logo-wall cell rules, section grid lines, and secondary button borders — 17 uses as an opaque rule where a hairline must survive overlapping layers. |
| Signal Blue | `#266df0` | `--color-signal-blue` | Mockup "Send email" buttons, the Platform section label text, and checked checkboxes — 21 fills. It is the chrome's only hue. Do not promote it to the marketing CTA. |
| Signal Wash | `#e5eeff` | `--color-signal-wash` | Section-label badge fill behind Signal Blue text, and selected-row tints in mockups — the blue at whisper strength, so a label reads as a tab rather than a button. |
| Mint Chip | `#e0fced` | `--color-mint-chip` | ICP score chips, positive status pills, and orbit-diagram tags — 17 uses. It is a data tint. Never use it as a section background. |

## Tokens — Typography

### Inter Display — the display cut that carries every section headline at one medium weight · `--font-inter-display`

- **Substitute:** Inter Display (rsms, free) at 500, which is identical. Alternatively, use Inter variable with `opsz` 32 at 500. Geist at 500 is a third option, but it draws marginally lighter, so do not drop below 500.
- **Weights:** 500, 600
- **Sizes:** 24px, 32px, 40px, 68px
- **Line height:** 1.05–1.15
- **Letter spacing:** -0.24px at 24px, -0.8px at 32px, -0.4px at 40px, -1.36px at 68px (estimated)
- **OpenType features:** `"ss03"`, `"calt"`
- **Role:** Weight 500 at 40px is the signature. Headlines are large but conversational, with none of the 700-weight shouting that SaaS convention reaches for. The 24 to 32 to 40px steps run a Perfect Fourth and then a Major Third, a compressed ladder that never lets one headline dominate the next. Tracking is deliberately tightest at 32px (-0.025em), where the cut would otherwise look loose, and relaxes to -0.01em at 40px.

### Inter — the UI and body voice, set almost entirely at 500 · `--font-inter`

- **Substitute:** Inter (rsms, free) at 500, which is identical. Geist at 500 is also suitable. IBM Plex Sans at 400 works too: it draws heavier than its nominal weight and matches Inter 500's stroke.
- **Weights:** 400, 500, 600
- **Sizes:** 6px, 8px, 9px, 10px, 11px, 12px, 13px, 14px, 15px, 16px, 18px
- **Line height:** 1.0–1.5
- **Letter spacing:** -0.16px at 6–13px and 16px, -0.13px at 13px, -0.14px at 14px body, -0.07px at 14px buttons, -0.28px at 14px emphasis, -0.15px at 15px, -0.18px at 18px
- **OpenType features:** `"ss03"`
- **Role:** Medium 500 is the default for body text, a deliberate anti-convention move: 446 uses at 500 against only 43 at 400. Paragraphs therefore carry the same density as UI labels. The constant -0.16px tracking flattens small sizes into a single texture that matches the product's own interface. Sizes from 6px to 9px exist only inside scaled mockups. The 531 `ss03` applications swap in Inter's rounded punctuation set across the whole page.

### Tiempos Text — a serif reserved for customer voices · `--font-tiempos-text`

- **Substitute:** Source Serif 4 at 400. Newsreader at 450 is an alternative: it draws lighter than Tiempos at the same nominal weight, so bump it. Charter at 400 is a third option.
- **Weights:** 400
- **Sizes:** 48px
- **Line height:** 1.083
- **Letter spacing:** -0.72px at 48px
- **OpenType features:** `"ss03"`
- **Role:** A transitional serif at 48px across 17 nodes is how Attio marks words that are not its own, namely testimonial quotations. It is the only 400-weight display face, so quotations read as printed testimony rather than product claims. The pairing works because it is rationed to that single job.

### Type Scale

| Role | Family | Weight | Size | Line Height | Letter Spacing | Token |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| small | Inter | 500 | 10px | 1.5 | -0.16px | `--text-small` |
| caption | Inter | 500 | 12px | 1.333 | -0.16px | `--text-caption` |
| body-sm | Inter | 500 | 13px | 1.385 | -0.13px | `--text-body-sm` |
| body | Inter | 500 | 14px | 1.429 | -0.14px | `--text-body` |
| body-lg | Inter | 500 | 15px | 1.333 | -0.15px | `--text-body-lg` |
| subheading | Inter Display | 500 | 24px | 1.15 | -0.24px | `--text-subheading` |
| heading-sm | Inter Display | 500 | 32px | 1.15 | -0.8px | `--text-heading-sm` |
| heading | Inter Display | 500 | 40px | 1.1 | -0.4px | `--text-heading` |
| heading-lg | Tiempos Text | 400 | 48px | 1.083 | -0.72px | `--text-heading-lg` |
| display | Inter Display | 500 | 68px | 1.05 | -1.36px | `--text-display` |

## Do's and Don'ts

### Do

- Set every headline, label and paragraph at weight 500 — one weight across 490 of 614 text nodes is what makes the system feel typeset rather than assembled.
- Split section headlines into a #242629 lead clause and a #75777c continuation at the same 40px size — this is the signature, and it replaces a separate subhead.
- Keep the marketing CTA in #242629 with the sm bevel shadow and a 10px radius — the dark key is non-negotiable, because blue belongs to the product.
- Draw structure with 1px #0000000d or #e6e7ea rules — hairline grids let logo walls and feature tiles share walls like spreadsheet cells.
- Stage product mockups on #f4f5f6 and lift them with the lg five-layer shadow — the tonal step plus a 0.04-opacity spread reads as depth without drama.
- Hold Inter body tracking at -0.16px from 10px to 13px — the constant negative tracking matches the app UI and fuses small text into one texture.
- Separate major sections by 112px and cap text columns at 880px — the generous vertical rhythm offsets the dense 14px UI type inside each section.

### Don't

- Don't bold headlines to 700 for emphasis — 500 at 40px is the whole thesis, and heavier weights turn a conversational ledger into a billboard.
- Don't recolor the primary button #266df0 because "CTAs should be blue" — Signal Blue is rationed to labels and in-product actions, and spending it on chrome erases the boundary.
- Don't use the mockup hues (#00d17e, #9b69ff, #f97514, #ff5454) for icons, section bands or illustrations — they are data colors, and outside mockups they read as a confetti palette.
- Don't add a separate 18px subhead paragraph under a 40px heading — the gray continuation clause already does that job, and stacking both doubles the hierarchy.
- Don't round content cards to 20px or more — the system tops out at 12px for cards, and the 23px shell is reserved for simulated OS windows.
- Don't push shadow opacity above 0.25 or use neutral black for large drops — elevation here is navy-tinted (rgba 0, 22, 62) and should be felt rather than seen.
- Never set body copy in #9fa1a7 — Pewter Muted is for inactive tabs and placeholders, and at 14px it falls below a readable contrast against #ffffff.

## Agent Prompt Guide

**Quick Color Reference**

- text: #242629 (Graphite Ink)
- secondary text: #75777c (Slate Caption)
- background: #ffffff (Paper Canvas)
- product stage: #f4f5f6 (Mist Panel)
- border: #0000000d (Ash Hairline)
- accent: #266df0 (Signal Blue)
- primary action: #242629 (filled action)

**Color in Data**

Charts and tables default to neutral #242629 and #75777c strokes. Positive values take a #e0fced tint chip with dark text, and Signal Blue #266df0 may appear as a solid fill only on single marks such as a selected bar or checkbox, so no data element ever outweighs the headline ink.

**Example Component Prompts**

1. Build a Primary Action Button: an anchor element with display inline-flex, height 36px, padding 0 12px, background #242629, 1px solid #242629 border, border-radius 10px, text color #ffffff, font Inter at 14px, weight 500, line-height 20px and letter-spacing -0.07px, with box-shadow `inset 0.2px 0.2px 2px 0px rgba(255,255,255,0.1), 0px 1.5px 1.5px 0px rgba(0,0,0,0.25)`. Place it to the right of a matching secondary button with a #ffffff background, #242629 text, 1px solid #e6e7ea border and the same 10px radius and 36px height, separated by an 8px gap.

2. Build a static navigation bar: a full-width #101112 announcement strip 48px tall with centered #ffffff Inter 14px weight-500 text and a right-aligned 32px close button with a 10px radius. Below it, place a transparent bar on #ffffff with a 1px #0000000d bottom border and an inner container max-width of 1440px. On the left, set the wordmark in #101112, then links "Platform" and "Resources" (with chevrons, padding 0 8px 0 12px) followed by "Developers", "Customers" and "Pricing" (padding 0 12px). Set the links in Inter at 15px, weight 500, letter-spacing -0.16px, color #242629, in 36px-tall cells with a 10px radius and a #f4f5f6 hover fill. On the right, place the Sign in outlined button and the Start for free dark button with an 8px gap. Do not make the bar sticky.

3. Build a hero section: centered on #ffffff with 152px top padding. Stack an Inter 12px weight-500 #75777c eyebrow link, then a headline in Inter Display at 68px, weight 500, line-height 1.05, letter-spacing -1.36px and color #242629, then a 15px Inter weight-500 #75777c description capped at 512px wide, then the outlined and dark button pair with an 8px gap and 32px top margin. Below, at a 48px gap, place an app-window mockup with a #ffffff body, a 23px radius, 12px traffic-light dots, a #f4f5f6 sidebar and a 1px #0000000d divider, under box-shadow `0px 0px 0px 1px rgba(11,13,24,0.06), 0px 1px 2px rgba(11,13,24,0.024), 0px 3px 6px rgba(11,13,24,0.03), 0px 8px 14px rgba(11,13,24,0.035), 0px 16px 28px rgba(11,13,24,0.04)`.

4. Build a feature section with a two-tone heading: inside a frame with 1px #e6e7ea left and right rails, add 112px top padding and a 6px-radius badge with a #e5eeff fill, #266df0 text, Inter 12px weight 500 and 2px 6px padding. At a 16px gap, add an h2 capped at 880px wide in Inter Display at 40px, weight 500, line-height 1.1 and letter-spacing -0.4px, whose first sentence is #242629 and whose continuation is a span in #75777c. Below, place a two-column grid of tiles sharing 1px #e6e7ea walls, each with 32px padding, a 14px weight-500 #242629 title, a #75777c description at an 8px gap, and no radius or shadow.

### Outlined Button — Light (Secondary)

**Role:** Sign-in and sales-contact alternatives.

A white hairline twin. It uses a #ffffff background, #242629 text and a 1px solid #e6e7ea border, with a 10px radius, 0 12px padding and a 36px height, set in Inter at 14px, weight 500 and -0.07px tracking, under the subtle shadow. It shares every dimension with the primary, so the pair differs only in ink value. Use it for "Sign in", "Talk to sales" and "Reject", always placed left of the dark button.

**Role:** Static top bar with wayfinding.

A transparent, unpinned strip. It sits on #ffffff with a 1px #0000000d rule beneath, and the full header measures 116px including the announcement bar. The wordmark sits on the left inside a 12px-radius hit area with 8px 4px padding. Links are set in Inter at 15px, weight 500 and -0.16px tracking in #242629, in 36px-tall, 10px-radius cells: 0 8px 0 12px padding for the Platform and Resources dropdowns, and 0 12px for the others. Sign in and Start for free sit on the right. The bar is not sticky, which signals that content outranks chrome.

### Announcement Bar

**Role:** Release callout above navigation.

A full-bleed ink ribbon. It uses a #101112 background and #ffffff text, set in Inter at 14px and weight 500 with a trailing arrow glyph, with a close icon at the far right inside a 32px square button with a 10px radius. It is the only inverted band on the home page. The darkest surface is rationed to a single 48px strip so the news reads as a headline above the masthead.

### App Window Mockup — Main Content Card

**Role:** Product screenshot as primary illustration.

A rendered desktop window. It uses a #ffffff body with 12px 12px 0 0 top corners, three traffic-light dots (red, amber, green, all mockup-internal) and a #0000000d hairline between sidebar and canvas, with a 23px outer shell radius under the lg five-layer shadow. The sidebar sits on #f4f5f6, and interior type is Inter at 13–14px, weight 500, in #242629 and #505155. The 23px shell is the system outlier, allowed because the mockup simulates an operating-system window, which carries its own radius.

### Logo Wall Grid

**Role:** Customer proof as ruled cells.

A ledger of names. It is a five-column, two-row grid on #fbfbfb, with every cell divided by 1px #e6e7ea rules and wordmarks centered in #101112 monochrome. A small 10px arrow glyph in #9fa1a7 marks case-study links in the top-right corner. Cell height is 64px (estimated). There is no radius and no shadow. The ruling turns social proof into a spreadsheet row rather than a floating carousel, echoing the CRM table it advertises.

### Section Label Badge

**Role:** Eyebrow naming each section.

A tinted tab. It uses a #e5eeff fill and #266df0 text, set in Inter at 12px, weight 500 and -0.16px tracking, with a 6px radius, 2px 6px padding, no border and no shadow, placed 16px above the section heading. It is the one place Signal Blue enters marketing chrome. It labels rather than invites, so it never takes a hover state.

### Two-Tone Section Heading

**Role:** Headline plus continuation in one block.

A sentence in two inks. It is set in Inter Display at 40px, weight 500, line-height 1.1 and -0.4px tracking. The lead clause ("The intelligent system that never sleeps.") is #242629, and the continuation runs on in #75777c within the same block, capped at 880px wide. The 24px h3 variant repeats the split inside feature tiles. It replaces the conventional headline-plus-subhead pair with a single typographic object, so the gray value does the work of a size change.

### Feature Split Tile

**Role:** Two-up capability explainer.

An open, borderless cell. It sits on #ffffff inside a 1px #e6e7ea grid, with 32px padding, a heading in Inter at 14px and weight 500 in #242629, and a description in #75777c beneath it. A live illustration fills the lower 60% (an AI prompt bar or an orbit diagram of status chips). It has no radius and no shadow. The tiles share walls like spreadsheet cells, keeping features as equals rather than ranked cards.

### Status Chip — Mockup Data

**Role:** Scores and tags inside visuals.

A tinted data token. It uses a #e0fced fill with text and border hues (#007d53 and #cbf7e1, both mockup-internal) for positive scores. Sibling tints in amber, violet and blue appear for other tags, all decorative and not system tokens. It is set in Inter at 11px with weight 500, with a 6px radius, 2px 6px padding, and a 1px border in the chip's own hue. This is the only home for multiple hues, and the chips stay small enough that color reads as data rather than branding.

### AI Prompt Input

**Role:** Agent query field in tiles.

A floating command line. It uses a #ffffff background and #9fa1a7 placeholder text, set in Inter at 14px with weight 500 and -0.07px tracking, with a 10px radius, 10px 13px padding, a 40px height and the md shadow. A 24px square send key with a 6px radius and #266df0 fill sits at 40% opacity until text exists. It borrows the product's own input spec, so the marketing page and the app share one control.

### Vertical Tab Index

**Role:** Left-rail section switcher.

A typographic list. It is set in Inter at 15px, weight 500 and -0.15px tracking. The active item is #242629, and inactive items ("Run sales motions", "Forecast revenue") are #9fa1a7, stacked with 8px gaps and carrying no indicators, underlines or fills. A 1px #e6e7ea rule separates the list from the content column. Selection is shown purely by ink value, the thesis applied to navigation.

### Consent Card

**Role:** Cookie notice, bottom-left floating.

A small white dialog. It uses a #ffffff background and #101112 text, set in Inter at 14px and weight 500, with a 16px radius, 24px padding and the md shadow. It holds a dark Continue button and an outlined Reject button, both at the 10px button spec, with a 12px gap. The 16px radius sits outside the card scale and is allowed because the dialog floats above every surface and needs a softer silhouette to read as transient.

## Do's and Don'ts

### Do

- Set every headline, label and paragraph at weight 500 — one weight across 490 of 614 text nodes is what makes the system feel typeset rather than assembled.
- Split section headlines into a #242629 lead clause and a #75777c continuation at the same 40px size — this is the signature, and it replaces a separate subhead.
- Keep the marketing CTA in #242629 with the sm bevel shadow and a 10px radius — the dark key is non-negotiable, because blue belongs to the product.
- Draw structure with 1px #0000000d or #e6e7ea rules — hairline grids let logo walls and feature tiles share walls like spreadsheet cells.
- Stage product mockups on #f4f5f6 and lift them with the lg five-layer shadow — the tonal step plus a 0.04-opacity spread reads as depth without drama.
- Hold Inter body tracking at -0.16px from 10px to 13px — the constant negative tracking matches the app UI and fuses small text into one texture.
- Separate major sections by 112px and cap text columns at 880px — the generous vertical rhythm offsets the dense 14px UI type inside each section.

### Don't

- Don't bold headlines to 700 for emphasis — 500 at 40px is the whole thesis, and heavier weights turn a conversational ledger into a billboard.
- Don't recolor the primary button #266df0 because "CTAs should be blue" — Signal Blue is rationed to labels and in-product actions, and spending it on chrome erases the boundary.
- Don't use the mockup hues (#00d17e, #9b69ff, #f97514, #ff5454) for icons, section bands or illustrations — they are data colors, and outside mockups they read as a confetti palette.
- Don't add a separate 18px subhead paragraph under a 40px heading — the gray continuation clause already does that job, and stacking both doubles the hierarchy.
- Don't round content cards to 20px or more — the system tops out at 12px for cards, and the 23px shell is reserved for simulated OS windows.
- Don't push shadow opacity above 0.25 or use neutral black for large drops — elevation here is navy-tinted (rgba 0, 22, 62) and should be felt rather than seen.
- Never set body copy in #9fa1a7 — Pewter Muted is for inactive tabs and placeholders, and at 14px it falls below a readable contrast against #ffffff.

## Imagery

There is no photography and no illustration in the conventional sense. The imagery is the product, rendered as live HTML mockups: a full Attio workspace window, a Slack-style pipeline thread, a video-call transcript panel, a companies table with ICP scores, and an email composer. The only photograph is a webcam still inside the call mockup. Mockups are framed as OS windows with traffic-light dots, a 12px or 23px radius, #0000000d hairlines and the lg five-layer shadow, floating over #f4f5f6 stages or a faint blue-violet vertical-stripe backdrop (decorative only, not a system token). Icons are 1.5px-stroke monoline glyphs at 14–16px in #75777c. A dark terminal panel set in JetBrains Mono 10px is mockup-internal. There are no gradient orbs and no glow. The narrative is "this is the software, already working".

## Layout

The outer container caps at 1440px, and headline columns run 880px or narrower inside a ruled frame of 1px #e6e7ea vertical rails. Sections are separated by 112px and stretch to 152px around the hero. The hero is centered: a 12px announcement link, a 68px Inter Display headline, a two-line 15px description, and paired 36px buttons, followed by a wide app mockup that overlaps the fold with satellite windows on either side. Sections alternate between white tiles and #fbfbfb or #f4f5f6 product stages. Feature tiles run two-up, and the logo wall is a five-column, two-row grid. The nav is static and transparent, 116px including the announcement bar, with the wordmark and five links on the left and two buttons on the right. The footer is a multi-column link directory. At 375px, drop the display size to 40px, section gaps to 48px, and grids to one column. Overall density is comfortable.

## Agent Prompt Guide

**Quick Color Reference**

- text: #242629 (Graphite Ink)
- secondary text: #75777c (Slate Caption)
- background: #ffffff (Paper Canvas)
- product stage: #f4f5f6 (Mist Panel)
- border: #0000000d (Ash Hairline)
- accent: #266df0 (Signal Blue)
- primary action: #242629 (filled action)

**Color in Data**

Charts and tables default to neutral #242629 and #75777c strokes. Positive values take a #e0fced tint chip with dark text, and Signal Blue #266df0 may appear as a solid fill only on single marks such as a selected bar or checkbox, so no data element ever outweighs the headline ink.

**Example Component Prompts**

1. Build a Primary Action Button: an anchor element with display inline-flex, height 36px, padding 0 12px, background #242629, 1px solid #242629 border, border-radius 10px, text color #ffffff, font Inter at 14px, weight 500, line-height 20px and letter-spacing -0.07px, with box-shadow `inset 0.2px 0.2px 2px 0px rgba(255,255,255,0.1), 0px 1.5px 1.5px 0px rgba(0,0,0,0.25)`. Place it to the right of a matching secondary button with a #ffffff background, #242629 text, 1px solid #e6e7ea border and the same 10px radius and 36px height, separated by an 8px gap.

2. Build a static navigation bar: a full-width #101112 announcement strip 48px tall with centered #ffffff Inter 14px weight-500 text and a right-aligned 32px close button with a 10px radius. Below it, place a transparent bar on #ffffff with a 1px #0000000d bottom border and an inner container max-width of 1440px. On the left, set the wordmark in #101112, then links "Platform" and "Resources" (with chevrons, padding 0 8px 0 12px) followed by "Developers", "Customers" and "Pricing" (padding 0 12px). Set the links in Inter at 15px, weight 500, letter-spacing -0.16px, color #242629, in 36px-tall cells with a 10px radius and a #f4f5f6 hover fill. On the right, place the Sign in outlined button and the Start for free dark button with an 8px gap. Do not make the bar sticky.

3. Build a hero section: centered on #ffffff with 152px top padding. Stack an Inter 12px weight-500 #75777c eyebrow link, then a headline in Inter Display at 68px, weight 500, line-height 1.05, letter-spacing -1.36px and color #242629, then a 15px Inter weight-500 #75777c description capped at 512px wide, then the outlined and dark button pair with an 8px gap and 32px top margin. Below, at a 48px gap, place an app-window mockup with a #ffffff body, a 23px radius, 12px traffic-light dots, a #f4f5f6 sidebar and a 1px #0000000d divider, under box-shadow `0px 0px 0px 1px rgba(11,13,24,0.06), 0px 1px 2px rgba(11,13,24,0.024), 0px 3px 6px rgba(11,13,24,0.03), 0px 8px 14px rgba(11,13,24,0.035), 0px 16px 28px rgba(11,13,24,0.04)`.

4. Build a feature section with a two-tone heading: inside a frame with 1px #e6e7ea left and right rails, add 112px top padding and a 6px-radius badge with a #e5eeff fill, #266df0 text, Inter 12px weight 500 and 2px 6px padding. At a 16px gap, add an h2 capped at 880px wide in Inter Display at 40px, weight 500, line-height 1.1 and letter-spacing -0.4px, whose first sentence is #242629 and whose continuation is a span in #75777c. Below, place a two-column grid of tiles sharing 1px #e6e7ea walls, each with 32px padding, a 14px weight-500 #242629 title, a #75777c description at an 8px gap, and no radius or shadow.

## Ink-Value Hierarchy

The discipline is that gray carries rank, not weight or size. With 500 used for nearly every node, the system separates levels by stepping through #242629, #75777c and #9fa1a7. Two-tone headlines and the vertical tab index both prove it: emphasis is a darker ink at the same size. The system breaks the moment anyone introduces 700 weight, a colored subhead, or an 18px paragraph wedged under a 40px heading. Each adds a second hierarchy channel that competes with value. To extend it, add a new level by inserting a gray between existing inks rather than a new weight. A new component should first ask which of the three inks it needs, and only then whether it needs 600, which is currently reserved for 8px mockup micro-labels.

## Quarantined Color

Attio runs a strict border between chrome and product. Marketing surfaces get one hue, #266df0, limited to labels and in-product actions. The product mockups get everything else: mint scores, violet tags, amber exec flags, orange and red status dots. The quarantine is what makes the screenshots feel alive against a grayscale page. It breaks if a section background goes violet, if feature icons pick up green, or if the CTA turns blue to "match the product". To add a new data hue, introduce it as a tint chip plus a dark text pair, and keep it inside a mockup frame. If a marketing component seems to need color, give it a #f4f5f6 surface step instead.

## Similar Brands

- **Linear** — The same move of using a rendered product window as the hero illustration with traffic-light chrome, though Linear sets it on a near-black canvas where Attio stays on #ffffff.
- **Vercel** — Shares the hairline-ruled grid cells for logo walls and features and a near-monochrome chrome. The difference is that Vercel leans on Geist at heavier display weights.
- **Notion** — Pairs a sans UI with a serif reserved for quotations and editorial moments, mirroring Attio's Tiempos testimonials, but on a warmer off-white canvas.
- **Stripe** — Uses the same navy-tinted, multi-layer, sub-0.05-opacity shadows to float product panels, though Stripe spends far more of its chromatic budget on gradients.
- **HubSpot** — A direct CRM competitor and the convention Attio rejects: bold orange CTAs and weight-700 headlines versus Attio's graphite key and 500-weight sentences.
